name: smwmusic-equinox-atlena
title: Equinox - Atlena
description:
Sampled port of an amazing composition by Tim Follin, for me one of the saddest melody lines played on SNES. It actually starts off quite scary, only getting sad closer to the end, as soon as the flute begins to play. Very useful for dark and desolate areas.
An alternate version is included, which loops before the original's actual end and prevents it from stopping for a few seconds.
